notes.title: New function "Connect" Major update　[07/19~07/31]
notes.content:
In this update, I will announce a new function "Connect", and a new design.

[h1]Connect[/h1]

[h3]You can play stages made by other players, and upload your original stage.[/h3]

Here's what it looks like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061100/8bc076ceee49a6e33be173a31d6c43adb6382a63.png[/img]
You can create, upload, and download stages here.

[h3]Steps to create stage↓[/h3]
1. Click the "Create" button with "edit mode"
2. Place the goal and exit stage with the stage cleared
3. Check if you passed the requirements, and click the "Upload (Replace)" button to submit

[h3]One stage per person. Create a stage with your best efforts.[/h3]

You can choose stages from the bottom right of the "Connect" top screen.

There is also a trophy element implemented to count the stages you cleared.

[b]Please note that the stage upload function is only available by 07/31/2024 JST.[/b]


[h2]New design[/h2]

To add more depth to the game screen, I've added new animation and adjusted some designs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45061100/cdb03fe6f5e7bf90596046d8d4ac8df2279792c8.png[/img]

+Several bug fix

If you encounter any trouble, please inform me.
Thank you.

notes.title: README.txt
notes.content:
Hello!
Thank you for reading this README.txt.
In this article, I'll be telling you about Q&As of this game and further updates.

[h1]Q&A[/h1]

Q. What is this game?
A. This is a game where you draw a line to provide electricity into ●<--this shape, from ■<--this thing.

Q. Tell me a way to play.
A. Select a shape to place from the bottom box, and place the shape by dragging the mouse on the map. The angle of shapes will be changed to the way you dragged it.

Q. It's too difficult to clear.
A. You are able to skip the "gen" by pressing the S key.

Q. The game screen is going crazy!
A. Please inform the issue on the Steam community thread, so I can fix it(maybe).

[h1]Further updates[/h1]

Now, I'm planning to release,

[h3]・One major update

・One medium update

・Several hotfixes[/h3]

Please be aware that both major and medium updates do not completely change the fundamental game system and it's just additional content.
The release date is planned to be within two weeks from the game release(07/05/2024) for the major one, and one month for the medium one.
Now, I've started a new project that requires many works. However, because of insufficient human resources(1 full-time employee<--me!), Additional contents of the game Breakthrough are estimated to be few. I am so sorry, but I would like to ask for your understanding.
